scope: One original take per prompt: 28 subtle effects across seven games, six ambience beds and nine sparse details for the three strategy worlds.
status: Complete: 43 clips generated, downloaded, decoded and level-checked; subjective listening acceptance pending
notes: Each clip was generated once successfully. An initial oversized dispatch returned explicit 429 rejection for unstarted nodes; accepted sessions were polled, and only unstarted nodes were dispatched later in bounded batches.

Original generation files are preserved under assets/audio/elevenlabs/2026-09-26/. Runtime copies have conservative peak normalization and short one-shot edge fades; looping beds retain their generated seams.
Prompts describe intended content; semantic and subjective listening acceptance has not been performed.
